comment: DirtBox - three distortion models in one effect plus an automatic noise reducer, mono. DS-1 = the built-in distortion of the Behringer TD-3 303 clone (a Boss DS-1 copy), RAT = the ProCo RAT, METAL = the Boss MT-2 Metal Zone; each follows a circuit analysis or model of the pedal (ElectroSmash + DS1.lv2, Rudro085 Proco-Rat, guitarix MetalTone). ZNR listens to the clean input, measures the noise floor itself (capped at -60 dBFS) and gently expands the wet signal below it, holding 50 ms and releasing over 150 ms so kick tails fade naturally. Makeup keeps the wet near the input level whatever the Drive.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox (this pack). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Model
params.comment: Distortion model: 0 DS-1 (the TD-3's built-in distortion, a Boss DS-1 copy), 1 RAT (ProCo RAT), 2 METAL (Boss MT-2 Metal Zone). Changing it fades the wet back in over ~6 ms. Default DS-1.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: The pedal's Dist knob. DS-1: 56x booster then 1..22x; RAT: 1..2100x audio taper; METAL: 1.2..55x after a +25 dB mid pre-filter. DS-1 and METAL still distort at 0, like the pedals. Makeup keeps the loudness roughly steady, so Drive mostly adds dirt. Default 50.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: 100 = brightest on every model. DS-1: the DS-1 tone pot, blending a 234 Hz low-pass with a 1.06 kHz high-pass (mids scooped in the middle). RAT: the RAT Filter, 475 Hz..16 kHz low-pass. METAL: the MT-2 High knob, -20..+20 dB shelf, flat at 50. Default 50.

params.name: ZNR
params.comment: Automatic noise reducer on the wet path. The threshold sits this far above the measured noise floor: +6 dB at 1 .. +24 dB at 100 (+15 dB at 50). The floor is capped at -60 dBFS so the threshold never climbs into the music. 0 = off. Default 50.

params.name: Level
params.comment: Wet output level, 0 .. 2x. 50 = about the input level (an input peaking near -14 dBFS comes out at about the same peak at any Drive).

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full up to 50, wet full from 50, both full at 50 (parallel distortion: the clean kick stays under the dirt).

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
